rules.topic: Every Energized Power number - capacities, transfer rates, per-tick consumption, recipe durations, production - is a registered config default in ModConfigs.java; the values in this file are those defaults, and a server config can move all of them

Solar panel peak production by tier (FE/t at full sun): tier I 2, II 16, III 128, IV 2048, V 16384, VI 131072 - the ladder is roughly x8 per tier with a jump at IV, so early tiers are trickle power and the mod's real generation starts at tier IV

Item battery capacities by tier (FE): I 256, II 1024, III 2048, IV 8192, V 16384, VI 65536, VII 262144, VIII 1048576; charge/discharge rates run 2 to 32768 FE/t on the same ladder - even the top battery is small next to other mods' storage, this mod's economy is deliberately compact at the low end
Crusher: 8 FE/t for 100 ticks per recipe (800 FE per operation). Advanced crusher: 32 FE/t for 25 ticks - four times faster at four times the draw, the same 800 FE per recipe (lines 669-675)
